name: MongoDB Atlas
description: Call the Atlas Administration API (projects, clusters, users) with a service account token.

fields.label: Service account access token
fields.help: Create a service account (Organization → Access Manager → Applications), then exchange its client ID/secret at https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/oauth/token. Tokens expire after 1 hour. The old Data API was retired; API keys use HTTP Digest, which isn't supported here.
